workflow.name: Deep Diagnostic Analysis
workflow.trigger: debug, error analysis, log analysis, root cause, why is this happening, investigate error
workflow.description: Comprehensive debugging with root cause and contributing factor analysis.

step.goal: Forensic analysis of error context, logs, and stack traces. Identify the fault boundary and failure propagation path. Document symptoms and immediate causes.

Analyze systemic factors: data flow, integration points, state management. Document root cause AND contributing factors. Determine if issue is isolated or indicates design flaw. Output as design_doc with "Diagnostic: " title prefix.
Implement explicit remediation steps addressing root cause. Add defensive measures for contributing factors. Create regression test capturing the failure mode.
Verify root cause is addressed (not just symptoms). Confirm contributing factors are mitigated. Check for introduced regressions.
